note: Every place this archive can put a document in. The dark line is the documented descent, in order, from a headmen's list of 1679 to a house in Brisbane.

places.name: Rijeka
places.what: 66 indexed entries — the heaviest concentration anywhere. Carlo's great-uncle's branch came here from the County of Pazin about 1740.

people.n: Franciscum Josephum Aloysium Joannem Nepomuc Defranceschi
Joannes / Giovanni Nepomucenus Aloysius Paschalus Defranceschi
Antonium Petrum Nataliem Joannem Kepomuc Defranceschi

places.name: Gologorica
places.what: Carlo's great-great-grandfather Giambattista, son of the late Leonardo, builds the family house — the year cut into it. His descendants farm the bishop of Pedena's rent here until the diocese is suppressed.

places.name: Vodnjan
places.what: Dignano. Five generations of De Franceschi read out of the parish books by eye, back to a marriage of the 1770s — because the marriage register is indexed nowhere. A priest, a ploughman and a weaver, all sons of one Giuseppe; a second line from a Domenico; and four women of the name married out before the books open.

places.name: Svetvinčenat
places.what: Elena, daughter of Francescho di Franceschi and Eufemia, 21 December 1628 — read off the page. A settled household a generation and a half before the 1666 baptisms, and 33 years before Moncalvo.

places.name: Omiš
places.what: The Omiš branch.

people.n: Pietro Antonio detto Perini de Franceschi

places.name: Pula
places.what: 34 entries. A separate presence again from the Franceschi «venuti da Capodistria» before the 1631 plague.

places.name: Ližnjan
places.what: 18 entries — with Premantura and Medulin, a southern group with no visible link to the central-Istrian line.

places.name: Kaštelir
places.what: 4 entries.

places.name: Mione di Ovaro
places.what: A Zuane De Franceschi of Mione is listed working in the County of Pazin with his son. The only document that shows the journey at all.
also: Mione, Ovaro, Udine, Friuli Venezia Giulia, Italia

places.name: Gračišće
places.what: Gallignana. House 5, the farmer Joannes Baptista. House 19, his son Antonius the lapicida. And on 22 March 1863 the baptism of Josephus.

places.name: Rovinj
places.what: Carlo was appointed to the court here in 1850; his son Camillo took refuge here in the war.

places.name: Bakar
places.what: 6 entries, including a Nodburga Defranceschi.

people.n: Joannem / John / Joannes / Ivan / Giovanni Baptista Defranceschi

places.name: Paluzza
places.what: De Franceschi in the registers from the 1780s.

places.name: Pazin
places.what: Conraddus Vincentius and Liberatus Franciscus Xaverius Defranceschi. A Vincenzo was Chancellor of the County in that century.

people.n: Angelo Eustode Pietra Giovanni Nepomuceno Defranceschi

places.name: Crikvenica
places.what: Josip and Ana's household. Six children, three of them dead before thirteen. Josip entered in 1906 as «vešti klesar sada tvorničar».

places.name: Horsham, Victoria
places.what: Zdravko and Ruža reached Australia on 8 March 1949. Both are buried here.

places.what: Hedviga died here on 30 October 2001, six years to the day after her husband died at Senj. David was born here.

places.name: Klenovica
places.what: Anton Rudolf baptised at house 22, and against the parents' place of origin the priest writes «Gallignana u Istriji» — the zavičaj that welds the coast to the hill.

places.name: Senj
places.what: Ivan went home. He worked here, married Hedviga Blažević, and is buried under a slab cut IVAN DEFRANČESKI.

also: Willowbank, City of Ipswich, Queensland, Australia

places.name: Arroio do Tigre, Brazil
places.what: The largest cluster of the surname anywhere — the Veneto colonies of Rio Grande do Sul.

places.name: Bad Urach
places.what: Where his elder daughter was born.

places.name: Bergamo
places.what: «I nostri in origine erano da Bergamo, poi venuti in Carnia, dove avevano castelli» — family tradition reported by Carlo, at second hand, and nothing more.

places.name: Bribir
places.what: Giambattista, meant for the priesthood, made castellan here after the Seven Years' War — and besieged by forty brigands.

places.name: Buenos Aires
places.what: And where others of the eleven went.

places.name: Dachau
places.what: Antonius Franciscus Defranceschi of Gologorica, 1909–1945, died here.

places.name: Fužine
places.what: Where Ruža Hreljac was born on 13 February 1922.

places.name: Givigliana
places.what: Where Poldo dal Ginut married Giacomina Gortana in the church of St Peter.

places.name: Harare
places.what: Ivan and Hedviga's first move out of Europe.

places.name: Heraklion
places.what: Candia. Where the Seget branch says it came from.

places.name: Imotski
places.what: The Dalmatian Franceschi, descended from Zuane, Venetian commander and governor after the town was taken from the Ottomans. Not this family — an online tree spliced them on.

places.name: Ipswich, Queensland
places.what: Anton — the child written «enfant» across a camp card — is buried at Warrill Park, an hour from Brisbane.

places.name: Karlobag
places.what: The deepest ancestry in the archive: Pilipić, Uroda, Gerkacs, Smojver Vukić, reaching people born about 1690.

places.name: Krivi Put
places.what: House 136 — where Antonija Prpić was baptised on 15 May 1859.

places.name: Metzingen
places.what: Where Petar's younger daughter was born.

places.name: Muina
places.what: Osvaldo de Franceschi, farmer, born 14 March 1788, son of Antonio, son of the late Leonardo.

places.name: Neuhausen an der Erms
places.what: Kelterstraße 30. Petar married Luise Salzer here in February 1942 and stayed for good.

places.name: New York
places.what: Where several of the eleven children of Josip's elder brother went.

places.name: Oprtalj
places.what: Franceschini, not Defranceschi — a different formation of the same root.

places.name: Proložac
places.what: Perinuša, the mills on the Vrljika.

places.name: Reutlingen
places.what: Where the brothers ended up. Petar from April 1939, Ivan from October 1941 aged sixteen, Zdravko after the Partisans took him in 1943. IRO numbers 148.901 and 148.902.

places.name: Seget
places.what: The Venetian branch buys the estate near Umag. Carlo records them as «emigrata dall'isola di Candia» after the Turks took Crete in 1669.

places.name: Trogir
places.what: Given on the family's own map as the birthplace of the Zuane Defranceschi famous in the Omiš war against the Turks.

places.name: Šišan
places.what: Sissano. A wedding held here in January 1824 was witnessed by «Pietro De Franceschi di Gio., da Dignano, Tessitore» — the town-name written down only because he was standing outside it.
